map.以 1000 kg 草鱼、水温 25℃、均重 200 g 估算日投喂: Estimating daily feeding for 1000 kg of grass carp at 25°C and 200 g average weight
map.水温 25℃ 处于适温区间，草鱼投喂率约 2.5%~3%；日投喂量 = 1000: A water temperature of 25°C is in the optimal range, where the grass carp feeding rate is about 2.5%~3%; daily feed amount = 1000 kg × 3% = 30 kg. Feed 3~4 times a day (morning, noon and evening), choosing a 3~4 mm particle size to match the mouth size; if the temperature drops below 15°C, the feeding rate should fall to within 1% and the frequency should be reduced.
map.水温变化怎么调整投喂率？: How do you adjust the feeding rate when the temperature changes?
map.多数温水性鱼类在 20~30℃ 摄食旺盛，投喂率取 2%~4%；低于 15℃ 消: Most warm-water fish feed actively at 20~30°C, where the feeding rate is 2%~4%; below 15°C digestive capacity drops, so it should fall to about 1% or be fed every other day; below 10°C most species stop feeding. During rainy or overcast days and around oxygen depletion, the amount should also be reduced or feeding stopped.
map.饲料粒径怎么选？: How do you choose the feed particle size?
map.粒径以鱼体口裂能顺利吞咽为准，一般约为鱼体体长的 1/4~1/3 或依品种规格表: The particle size should be one the fish can swallow comfortably, generally about 1/4~1/3 of body length or per the species size table (e.g. grass carp at 50 g uses 1.5~2 mm, at 200 g uses 3~4 mm, at 500 g uses 4~5 mm). Too large is hard to swallow and too small creates wasteful dust, so the size should be stepped up as the fish grow.
